blocks.orig: Unguja Ukuu is a village in the south of Zanzibar, way off the popular tourist radar, where you can hop on a boat to the peaceful and uninhabited islands of Mimi and Nianembe in the protected Menai Bay. This is a private, full-day excursion in a traditional (but motorized) dhow. It takes approximately 45 minutes to reach the islands and you might even spot some dolphins along the way. Once there you can make a stroll, go snorkeling and enjoy the best lunch of freshly caught fish!
blocks.html: Far from the usual tourist routes, Unguja Ukuu is a village in the south of Zanzibar where you can take a boat to Mimi and Nianembe, two quiet, uninhabited islands in the protected Menai Bay. The private, full-day excursion takes place in a traditional dhow (with a motor). Getting to the islands takes about 45 minutes, and you may even see dolphins on the way. On the islands you can go for a walk, snorkel and enjoy a superb lunch of freshly caught fish!
